reviews.comment: He is a knowledgeable professor who is definitely passionate about the subject, but I think he assumes you would know more about the subject than you do. He doesn't go really in depth about topics, so conceptual stuff you learn on your own. Other than that, very nice guy with an easy A or B final. Mainly follows Holt in terms of course structure.
Great guy, final was easier than Holt's, it does get hard to hear him but just sit in the front of the class and you'll be fine
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Seems to care more about being here for the benefits of funding for his research projects rather than actually caring to teach. He doesn't actually take time to explain anything, and just throws random equations and letters up and expects you to solve them during lectures. Had to go to Holt's office hours to actually understand anything.
